Name: Batch Plugin Cleaner
Author: GoriRed
Description: A batch plugin cleaner that runs your load order via xEdit's Quick Auto Clean. Keeps track of results so when re-run it knows which mods have already been processed.

ReleaseNotes: Add ability to multi-select plugins and mass Enable / Disable / Ignore them.
Added Reset All option instead of having to close and reopen the plugin to reset to default selected states.
Made it clear when plugins are affected by 'First dynamic plugin' and ability to clear.
